cargo-table.name: Cargo Table
cargo-table.role: Onboarding, first profit, first meaningful read

hiddenInfo.rule: The first aggressive action of each hand costs 10 less for the acting player.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results can yield low or mid-tier valuables. First clears strongly bias toward the Ivory Chip.

ledger-cellar.name: Ledger Cellar
ledger-cellar.role: Mid-stakes pressure room with quieter opponents and tighter reads

hiddenInfo.rule: The room is quieter, but every table tool use raises 1 extra heat. Soft reads matter more than brute pressure.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results tend to pay out layered valuables that bridge the run into Mirror Hall.

mirror-hall.name: Mirror Hall
mirror-hall.role: Main risk-reward table for the slice

hiddenInfo.rule: You may bring at most one valuable as collateral. Winning the final hand with collateral unlocks the best reward.
hiddenInfo.reward: Positive results grant high-tier valuables. The collateral line can pay out the Antique Commemorative Coin.

embers-table.name: Embers Table
embers-table.role: Late-run high stakes room where collateral and exposed goods both matter

hiddenInfo.rule: Luxury collateral is live here. If you close the room in profit, the room cools 1 heat before extraction math.
hiddenInfo.reward: The final room pays the heaviest luxury pieces, but it punishes weak exits harder than the others.

dock-braggart.name: Dock Braggart
dock-braggart.intro: Too loud for the cards he is actually holding.

ledger-clerk.name: Ledger Clerk
ledger-clerk.intro: Counts the room twice before he risks one chip.

calm-widow.name: Calm Widow
calm-widow.intro: Patient, precise, and excellent at noticing repetition.

smiling-knife.name: Smiling Knife
smiling-knife.intro: Coasts early, then leans on the table when the pot matters.

river-shark.name: River Shark
river-shark.intro: Looks passive until the pot starts smelling like a sure thing.

velvet-rook.name: Velvet Rook
velvet-rook.intro: Protects small edges and only turns sharp once the room gets narrow.

house-viper.name: House Viper
house-viper.intro: Never looks rushed, but the room tightens when he finally presses.

ash-smuggler.name: Ash Smuggler
ash-smuggler.intro: Hides under smoke and only shows teeth when the line looks soft.
